prediction: If the removed text pulls weight, arm b breaks the ceiling of T.1 (more than two em dashes) in most runs while arm a stays under it, and/or b exceeds a on T.2, T.3, R.1 and O.2. If the model writes this way unaided, the arms are indistinguishable on all of them. A check both arms fail says the guidance does not work as written, which is a third finding and not support for removing it. Four runs per cell measure no rate: they separate 'every time' from 'never'.
